visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera pans left from behind a white wall featuring a framed poster of food to reveal a brightly lit food court environment. A young woman with light brown hair, wearing a pink strapless dress, sits at a wooden table in the middle ground, focused on her meal. In the foreground, a blue shopping cart containing a pink bag partially obscures the view. (2) The camera moves forward, closing the distance to the woman as she continues to eat from a red tray with a red spoon. Other diners are visible in the background, seated at various tables under flat, bright indoor lighting. The woman maintains a neutral expression, unaware of the camera's approach until she looks up slightly. (3) The camera stabilizes on a medium close-up of the woman. She stops eating, holding her spoon mid-air, and looks directly into the lens with a surprised but amused expression, her eyes widening and a slight smile forming on her lips. Yellow and pink text overlays appear at the bottom of the frame during her reaction.
